children.name: Koeberlinia holacantha W.C.Holmes, K.L.Yip & Rushing
children.description: A shrub endemic to eastern Bolivia, growing in semi-arid desert and dry shrubland; described in 2008 and one of only two species of the genus Koeberlinia (family Koeberliniaceae, order Brassicales). Like its relative K. spinosa (allthorn), it is an intricately branched, essentially leafless shrub with rigid green photosynthetic, thorn-tipped branchlets.

children.name: Koeberlinia spinosa Zucc.
children.description: Koeberlinia spinosa is a species of flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico known by several common names, including crown of thorns, allthorn, smokebush, and crucifixion thorn.
